reason: For once this says what actually happens: 15 named companies in 5 days, nothing up front, pay only for meetings with real buyers. We have to replace lost volume, so I'd take the free list and if it looks like people I'd actually want to talk to, I'd let the pilot run.
objection: Every agency says 'qualified meetings' and then sends me a junior procurement clerk who took the call out of politeness. And '45 meetings in 2 months' with no name behind it is just a number on a slide. I also don't want my company name burned with spam in a market where everyone knows everyone.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 companies are names I already know or obviously wrong for us, I stop there and never start the pilot.
